# `accounts.current_account.AccountCredited`

A settlement CREDIT landed on the demand account ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md): ConfirmCredit -> Credit Movement) — the account RECEIVED money (a matured deposit, a loan disbursement, a coupon paid in). The credit was admitted UPSTREAM at ingestion by the family's credit-admission decider (a Closed/Erased account is refused by construction), so this fact is only ever appended for an account that could receive it. The Credit Movement is Observed in the [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) 'engine-internal already-effected' sense (the settlement saga already drove the cash leg and the CA records the landing), so no Originated header is emitted and the settlement predicate starts no SECOND saga on the account's own event (the loop-breaker). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | AccountId (Guid) — the account stream the credit is appended to. Never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `account_ref` | `string` | The account's opaque spine key the credit Movement posts against (AccountPosition.AccountRef) — a reference the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `amount_cents` | `long` | The credited amount as a positive integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1) — the source Movement.Amount the writer lands (the in-band WRONG-AMOUNT guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md)). Posted as a Credit so the accounting balance moves up. |
| `intent_reference` | `string` | The [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot-4 economic-intent reference the append command_id is derived from (via SettlementReferences.DeriveFromIntent) — carried for audit/lineage, NEVER the HTTP Idempotency-Key. A structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `value_date` | `int` (`date`) | ValueDate (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the credit's economic value-date, a caller-supplied input, never a clock read in a fold ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). |
| `movements` | `array<`record`>` | The credit as ONE Observed Credit Movement against account_ref ([ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md) slot 5). A REQUIRED array (an empty array, never null) defaulted to [] so pre-Movement records still decode (forward-only, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3 / BACKWARD compat). No Originated header is emitted (the loop-breaker), so this event starts no settlement saga. |
